bottlenecks.title: Agent commit_rewrite failed
bottlenecks.evidence: the agent failed: the full-history rewrite failed its own anonymity/syntax check (36 hard leak(s) {'tokens_head': 32, 'repo_or_owner_head': 2, 'repo_name_substrings_head': 2}, pa
bottlenecks.advice: Open the agent's log under _private/swarm/logs/. Everything that depends on it was skipped.

bottlenecks.title: pr_texts is the critical-path bottleneck
bottlenecks.advice: LLM-bound: titles for all, full text only for the scoped PRs.

bottlenecks.title: LLM calls were queued behind the worker limit
bottlenecks.evidence: 96% of LLM-busy time was at the limit (mean 6.5 workers)
bottlenecks.advice: More workers help up to ~12 on this account (20 was slower: provider throttling). If workers were held down by memory, give the container more.

bottlenecks.title: The commit_messages stage used the most LLM time
bottlenecks.evidence: 38530s of call time over 1090 calls (701.3 items/min)
bottlenecks.advice: Fewer items (scope) is the lever that scales; per-call speed is bounded by the model.
